_meta.description: Offline static intelligence for Bellandur, Bengaluru. All facts are sourced from named authoritative public sources. Values estimated without direct measurement are marked with lower confidence.

bmtc._source: BMTC published route maps at bmtcinfo.com and DULT Bengaluru origin-destination survey 2022-23. Bellandur has fewer BMTC routes than the ORR junction at Marathahalli.
bmtc._limitations: BMTC does not publish GTFS. Bellandur's residential areas are not well-served by BMTC; most residents rely on auto-rickshaws, Namma Yatri, or employer shuttles for last-mile.
bmtc.routeCountNote: Approximate count of BMTC routes with stops in Bellandur area from DULT survey. Bellandur is primarily served by ORR-corridor routes.
bmtc.majorRoutesNote: Representative list only; verify at bmtcinfo.com. Bellandur Stop on ORR is the main access point.

peakHeadwayMinutes.description: Typical peak-hour headway at Bellandur Stop (ORR)

nammaMetro._source: BMRCL published Purple Line Phase 2A station list. No Namma Metro station exists within the Bellandur OSM locality boundary.
nammaMetro._limitations: No operational metro station in Bellandur as of July 2026. The nearest stations are several kilometres away on the Purple Line.
nammaMetro.line: No operational station in Bellandur; nearest is Purple Line Phase 2A

nearbyStations.name: Whitefield (Kadugodi)
nearbyStations.note: Purple Line eastern terminus; accessible by road from Bellandur via ORR

nearbyStations.name: Silk Institute (Green Line)
nearbyStations.note: Green Line southern terminus near Silk Board; accessible from Bellandur via ORR

commuteDestinations._source: OpenStreetMap road network geometry; off-peak routing estimates via OSM topology
commuteDestinations._limitations: Drive times are indicative only. ORR at Bellandur is among the most congested stretches; peak times can be 3–6× off-peak. Sarjapur Road congestion affects south/east routes.

destinations.name: Ecospace Business Park / Prestige Tech Park (ORR Bellandur)

water._source: BWSSB published zone maps and reports 2022-23; multiple media reports on Bellandur water supply; Karnataka Jal Jeevan Mission progress reports; Citizen Matters Bellandur reporting 2022-23
water._license: Government public information; journalism attribution retained
water._limitations: BWSSB Cauvery pipeline coverage in Bellandur is very limited. Most areas are borewell-dependent. Bellandur Lake contamination means lake water is not usable as a source. Data from published reports.
water.authority: Bengaluru Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB) — very limited pipeline coverage
water.primaryWaterSource: Groundwater borewells (dominant); BWSSB/private tankers for areas without borewells; Cauvery pipeline only in select pockets
water.supplyFrequency: BWSSB piped supply where available: 2–3 days per week. Most of Bellandur residential area depends on borewells or tankers.
water.boreholeStatus: Bellandur has very high borehole dependence. Groundwater has historically been stressed given the large IT and residential population. Bellandur Lake catchment provides no potable water due to severe contamination.
water.sewageSystem: Limited BWSSB UGD; most apartments use combined STPs. Bellandur Lake receives significant untreated and partially-treated sewage from surrounding developments.
water.notes: BWSSB pipeline coverage in Bellandur is estimated at under 30% of built properties. Cauvery Stage V extension is planned for this area. The Lake Area Biodiversity Conservation and Management Plan (BBMP/BBMP Lake Development Authority) recognises Bellandur Lake's poor water quality. Source: National Green Tribunal orders 2018-2023, BBMP.

electricity._source: KERC Annual Performance Review 2023-24; BESCOM annual report 2022-23
electricity._limitations: SAIDI and SAIFI are BESCOM-zone aggregates.

ndvi._source: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance NDVI over Bellandur polygon via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. Analysis July 2024. Bellandur Lake and its buffer zones are major vegetation contributors as documented in NGT Bellandur lake restoration orders.
ndvi._license: Copernicus Sentinel data — free and open access under ESA Copernicus open data policy
ndvi._limitations: 10 m Sentinel-2 pixel; single dry-season composite. Bellandur Lake water surface may appear in NDVI as low-value pixels (water NDVI is typically negative). Buffer vegetation is included in the green cover percentage.
ndvi.ndviClassification: Moderate urban vegetation — Bellandur Lake wetland buffer and Kasavanahalli Lake area provide significant vegetation; commercial and residential built-up area has low NDVI
ndvi.comparisonContext: Bengaluru urban NDVI average ~0.20–0.28 (Ranagaswamy & Devaraj 2019). Bellandur's NDVI is near city average primarily due to its lake buffer zones — the built-up zones have much lower individual NDVI.
ndvi.lakeNote: Bellandur Lake (Bengaluru's largest urban lake at ~361 ha) is within or adjacent to the Bellandur OSM boundary. The lake itself and its mandated buffer zones contribute significantly to green cover NDVI values. Lake water quality is severely degraded — documented by the National Green Tribunal and CPCB reports 2016-2024.

heatIsland._source: Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature (Band 10); USGS Earth Explorer. Analysis comparing Bellandur polygon to rural reference, May 2024. Lake water bodies provide measurable LST cooling in Landsat imagery.
heatIsland._license: Landsat data is in the public domain (USGS/NASA)
heatIsland._limitations: 30 m Landsat thermal resolution. Lake surface cools adjacent land by 1–3°C; this moderates the measured locality-average LST. Surface temperature ≠ air temperature.
heatIsland.uhiClassification: Moderate urban heat island — lake cooling effect moderates overall locality average, but ORR commercial corridor and apartment zones can be 4–5°C above rural reference locally

ward._source: BBMP published ward delimitation 2022 (Mahadevapura Zone); Census of India 2011
ward.areaNote: Bellandur OSM locality includes the lake buffer area, Kasavanahalli, and ORR-adjacent residential zones.
ward.populationNote: 2011 Census population; substantially higher in 2024 following IT corridor apartment densification

complaints._source: BBMP Sahaaya grievance portal (FY 2022-23); iChangeMyCity; Citizen Matters Bellandur/ORR reports 2022-24; National Green Tribunal Bellandur Lake orders
complaints._license: Public grievance portal data; journalism and government orders; attribution retained
complaints._limitations: Complaint counts reflect only registered grievances. Bellandur's large apartment-dwelling IT workforce has a relatively higher civic complaint registration rate than city average.

totalComplaintsPerYear.note: Approximate registered complaints for Bellandur ward, FY 2022-23

topCategories.note: Bellandur Lake and its drains overflow during heavy monsoon. Areas near the lake and along Sarjapur Road have experienced annual flooding (2017, 2019, 2020, 2022). The National Green Tribunal has issued multiple orders directing BBMP to restore lake buffer zones.
Internal roads suffer from construction vehicle damage and monsoon deterioration. ORR service roads near Bellandur junction are frequently reported.

Bellandur Lake receives significant untreated sewage. Documented froth formation and fish kills have been reported and covered extensively by Citizen Matters and NGT. BBMP and BWSSB are under NGT directions to improve the STP capacity.
Borewell dry-up and BWSSB coverage gaps drive frequent water supply complaints.
Large apartment complexes require bulk waste collection coordination.

complaints.floodNote: IMPORTANT: The BBMP OpenCity KML flood-point dataset used for cell-level flood scoring in this application has 0 flood-evidence points within the Bellandur OSM boundary polygon. This is a known data gap — the KML points that document flood-prone areas near Bellandur Lake fall just outside the OSM locality boundary polygon used for data clipping. Bellandur is historically one of Bengaluru's most flood-affected areas. Cells near the lake should be assessed with this limitation in mind. Source: OpenCity flood data coverage analysis; NGT Bellandur orders; Citizen Matters flooding reports.

crime._source: NCRB Crime in India 2022 — Bengaluru City district-level; Karnataka SCRB Annual Report 2022
crime._limitations: Crime data available only at city/district level. No open ward-level crime breakdown exists for Bellandur.
crime.localityNote: Bellandur is served by Bellandur Police Station (Mahadevapura PS jurisdiction). No public database provides FIR counts or crime rates at ward or locality level.

internet._source: TRAI Broadband Report Q4 2023-24; Ookla Speedtest Global Index Bengaluru Q4 2023; ACT Fibernet, Airtel, Jio Fiber public coverage maps
internet._license: TRAI: public regulatory data; Ookla: research citations permitted
internet._limitations: TRAI data is circle-level. Apartment complexes near ORR are well-served; peripheral residential areas vary.
internet.fiberAvailability: Moderate-High — ORR corridor IT proximity drives good fiber infrastructure; apartment complexes are well-served

confirmedIsps.name: ACT Fibernet
confirmedIsps.coverageNote: Good coverage in Bellandur residential apartments
